rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The verse concerning those who mixed righteous and bad deeds was revealed about people who attended Badr and then stayed behind from Tabuk.
rows.anchor: «خلطوا عملا صالحا وآخر سيئا» نزلت فيمن شهد بدرا، وتخلف عن تبوك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The verse about others deferred to God’s command was revealed concerning those who stayed behind from Tabuk.
rows.anchor: وقوله: «وآخرون مرجون لأمر الله» نزلت فيمن تخلفوا عن تبوك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The verse was revealed concerning people the Muslims asked about after they had died while having prayed toward the qibla.
rows.anchor: «وما كان الله ليضل قوما» نزلت فيمن سأل عنهم المسلمون ممن صلى إلى القبلة فمات
